Design decisions (session 01a15e64):

- Gate semantics: both predicates return true only when env.DEV === true AND env.PROD !== true (defence in depth: a contradictory env fails closed) AND setting.shareTelemetryDev === true. Missing/undefined setting = off.
- Upload gate delegates to the collection gate so no build can upload what it could not collect; the gate module stays the single decision point.
- Endpoint path kept OUT of devMode.ts so the dev-only URL never ships via the production-reachable gate module; the bundle-hygiene marker '/api/telemetry/upload' stays reliable.
- Enforcement scan covers src/ + vite/ (browser/server production-reachable code); scripts/*.mjs is Node dev tooling and is not gated. Scan helpers are pure and fixture-tested so it provably detects violations (not just asserts today's empty live result).
- Bundle hygiene: added the dev upload endpoint as a forbidden marker; explicitly did NOT forbid the local sink key (ai_hell_telemetry_jsonl) since the jsonl sink ships with the telemetry framework in production.
